prompt:
Edit this exact B frame concept. The user likes this design. Preserve the four large dark rectangular rhythm-game keycaps completely, including their pressing surfaces, bevels, thickness, spacing and travel gaps. Preserve all outer frame armor, gauges, four lanes, lower bumper, colors and camera.

Change ONLY the front faces of the four fixed support blocks immediately UNDER the keycaps, which currently contain little round exhaust lights. Hollow out each entire rectangular/trapezoidal front face into ONE WIDE OPEN MOUTH occupying nearly its full width and height, leaving only a thin structural perimeter. Remove the old circular apertures and rings altogether. The whole formerly solid rectangular panel must now be a single uninterrupted open cavity. Keep the four key modules separate: ONE full-face opening PER KEY, not one shared slot across all four. No bars, no grille, no internal dividers, no round emitter sitting in the middle.

Light should come OUT OF THE WHOLE OPEN INTERIOR toward the viewer. Show depth in the cavities with a dark inner lip and recessed luminous interior, soft bloom and a little spill onto nearby edges. The second cavity emits pale cyan and the third emits warm gold, with the same shape and light pattern; the first and fourth are unlit deep open cavities. The output light fills the broad opening, not just a tiny point. These are hollow light-emitting openings, not solid LCD screens or luminous strips pasted onto solid faces.

Keep the upper keycaps opaque, large, tactile and unchanged. Keep the existing total height and width of the support blocks; hollow their front faces rather than enlarging the blocks. Same complete 1024x1536 portrait composition and mechanical illustration finish.
